status: Search cancellation and regular-expression contract for the cross-format command surface.

changes.old: OfficeIMO.Reader.OfficeDocumentReadResultExtensions.Search(OfficeDocumentReadResult document, string query, OfficeDocumentSearchOptions options = null)
changes.new: OfficeIMO.Reader.OfficeDocumentReadResultExtensions.Search(OfficeDocumentReadResult document, string query, OfficeDocumentSearchOptions options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
changes.reason: Search accepts cooperative cancellation for both literal and regular-expression matching. Existing source calls compile unchanged; binary consumers must recompile and method-group bindings must include the token or use a lambda. C# literal matching remains the default.

changes.replacement: Enumerate is lazy. Dispose the enumerator on early exit; document processors and handlers without incremental support use the documented materialized fallback.
changes.reason: Incremental sequences have the same vocabulary. EnumerateAsync remains available on .NET 8 and .NET 10.
Buffered asynchronous reads return the materialized document and its evidence; EnumerateAsync supplies asynchronous backpressure.
Folder sequences are explicitly incremental; detailed ingestion results retain their materialized names.

changes.old: OfficeDocumentReader.ReadTables / ReadTableExports / ReadVisuals / ReadVisualExports / ReadAssets / ReadStructured
changes.new: reader.ReadDocument(...).ExtractTables / ExportTables / ExtractVisuals / ExportVisuals / ExtractAssets / ExtractStructured
changes.replacement: Read the document once, then extract or export from its result. Existing chunks, tables and visuals have matching extraction/export extensions. Await ReadDocumentAsync before extraction.
changes.reason: Reading, extraction and export are explicit stages with one implementation each.
